title: How to Video Upscale with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to upscale a video to a higher resolution, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.
operation: Upscale a video to a higher resolution.
prompt: Upscale a video to a higher resolution.

fields.name: new_resolution
fields.purpose: Target maximum side length after upscale, e.g. 2160. Default: 2160.

fields.name: model_id
fields.purpose: Video upscale model id. Default: video-upscale-default.
